$Comment: The Costume Wand's primary (Jack Skeleton) cast. A ray from the eyes finds what the wand points at. A player gets the costume Hallows_Eve_Costume_Jack (ZigCostume), and only a costume that lands goes on to count USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Costume for the caster; a player it cannot dress (one already in a costume, under a transformation, or in this very costume) fizzles through ZigCostume's Failed. Any other creature fizzles through the second rule, and pointing at nothing fizzles through the Selector's Failed. ZigCostume never dresses the caster.
